questions.question: Choose the correct word to complete the sentence: 'At the end of summer, farmers gather their crops during the ___.' (contest / harvest / cloth)
questions.canDoStatement: I can identify and use target vocabulary related to harvest celebrations.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'In ancient times, two teams had a contest to ___ soft cloth.' (weave / pick / believe)
questions.canDoStatement: I can use action verbs related to crafting and traditions.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'Dad was ___ because there was not much water for the plants.' (worried / tidy / proud)
questions.canDoStatement: I can identify emotion adjectives in a story context.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: 'The strange space tomatoes have red and green ___.' (ancestors / stripes / machines)
questions.canDoStatement: I can use descriptive nouns to identify visual patterns.

questions.question: According to 'Chuseok: Korea's Harvest Festival', what did the king give to both teams after the month-long weaving contest?
questions.answer: He gave a big feast for both teams.
questions.canDoStatement: I can recall specific historical facts from an informational text.

questions.question: Why do Korean families hold a special ceremony and bow during Chuseok?
questions.answer: To remember and honor their ancestors and give thanks for the harvest.
questions.canDoStatement: I can explain cultural reasons and purposes described in a text.

questions.question: What is the secret setting of 'First Harvest', and how do we know at the end of the story?
questions.answer: The setting is an indoor farm on Mars. We know because Mom reminds the children to check their space suits and air supply, and their helmets say MARS 3000.
questions.canDoStatement: I can identify the time and place (setting) of a science fiction story using text clues.

questions.question: Which of the following words ends with the -st blend? (flag / nest / frog / tree)
questions.canDoStatement: I can identify words ending in the consonant blend -st.

questions.question: Write two words from 'First Harvest' that end with the letters -st: 1. h___ 2. f___
questions.canDoStatement: I can decode and write words with final -st from a reading selection.

questions.question: Complete the sentence using 'is' or 'are': 'There ___ pink potatoes, and there ___ a red pineapple on the table.'
questions.canDoStatement: I can correctly use 'There is' with singular nouns and 'There are' with plural nouns.

questions.question: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence expressing thankfulness: [the harvest / We / for / are / thankful / food .]
questions.answer: We are thankful for the harvest food.
questions.canDoStatement: I can form correct sentences using the pattern 'be thankful for [noun]'.

questions.question: Write 2 or 3 complete sentences about what you are thankful for and what special food you like to share with your family.
questions.answer: Accept any coherent 2-3 sentence response using target themes (e.g., 'I am thankful for my family and my home. We eat delicious rice cakes together at our feast.'). Criteria: 2 marks content & vocabulary, 1 mark grammar, 1 mark capitalization and periods.
questions.canDoStatement: I can write short descriptive sentences expressing personal gratitude and family celebrations.
